title: ShopNow E‑commerce UI
summary: React + Tailwind storefront with search, product detail, cart, and order flows.
description: Built a responsive e‑commerce front end using React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind CSS v4, and Vite 6. Features include client‑side product search, product detail pages, a cart with quantity controls, and an order checkout that collects delivery details. Navbar shows live cart count and login/register dropdown backed by localStorage.

gallery.alt: ShopNow home grid with products, search, cart, and user menu

problem: Provide a fast, modern shopping UI with clear flows for discovery, cart management, and placing orders—while keeping the stack simple (no backend).
approach: Client‑side routing for Home, Product Details, Cart, Orders, Login/Register (React Router)
Search input filters items from a local JSON catalog; product routes use URL params
Cart supports add/remove and quantity updates; order form creates an orders list
User menu uses localStorage for simple auth state; Tailwind v4 for responsive UI
outcomes: End‑to‑end demo of an e‑commerce flow (browse → detail → cart → checkout → orders)
Clear responsive design with accessible controls and visible cart badge
Ready to swap the local JSON catalog for an API or headless CMS

title: Realtime Chat Site
summary: Express + Socket.IO chat with login/signup and 1‑to‑1 realtime messaging.
description: A lightweight Node.js chat application using Express 5 and Socket.IO 4. Users log in and can message any online user from the live user list (pick anyone—even at random). Messages are delivered instantly over WebSockets. Static pages are served by Express. Deployed to Render.

gallery.alt: Chat conversation view with online users list

problem: Build a simple, reliable way for users to chat in real time from the browser.
approach: Created an Express server with Socket.IO for bidirectional communication
Implemented login/signup UI and a chat view with a live online users list
Direct 1‑to‑1 messaging: choose any user (including at random) and start chatting
Kept the codebase small and dependency-light for quick deploys on Render
outcomes: Stable realtime messaging with minimal latency
Simple UX that works across desktop and mobile browsers
Clear foundation for adding features like rooms, typing indicators, and message persistence

title: MERN Payroll Management System
summary: Full‑stack MERN dashboard with role‑based access, JWT auth, leave approvals, and payroll insights.
description: Built a complete payroll management system using React 19 (Vite), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MUI, and Node.js + Express + MongoDB. Features role-based dashboards (Admin, Manager, Employee), JWT authentication with refresh tokens, leave request workflows, compliance tracking, and interactive charts with Recharts. Seeded demo users for testing. Deployed to Render with separate client and API services.

gallery.alt: Admin dashboard with KPIs and charts

problem: Streamline payroll management and leave approvals across multiple user roles without manual spreadsheets and email threads.
approach: Architected a MERN stack with separate client (React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + MUI) and server (Express + TypeScript + MongoDB)
Implemented JWT auth with refresh tokens stored in secure httpOnly cookies and automatic rotation
Built role-based routes and dashboards for Admin, Manager, and Employee with protected routes
Used React Query for data fetching, caching, and optimistic updates; Zod for validation on both client and server
Integrated Recharts for interactive KPI charts and trends visualization
Seeded 3 demo users (admin, manager, employee) for quick testing and onboarding
outcomes: End-to-end payroll and leave management with clear role separation
Secure authentication with token refresh and CORS-protected API
Fast, responsive UI with optimistic updates and real-time chart feedback
Deployed on Render with persistent MongoDB Atlas storage

title: ShopHub E‑commerce Store
summary: Full‑stack MERN e‑commerce with Stripe payments, admin panel, reviews, and JWT auth.
description: Developed a production‑ready e‑commerce platform using the MERN stack (MongoDB Atlas, Express, React 18, Node.js). Features Stripe payment integration, user authentication with JWT, role‑based admin panel for product CRUD, customer reviews and ratings, responsive design, and order management. Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to Render with comprehensive documentation.

gallery.alt: ShopHub homepage with product grid and search
Product detail page with reviews and ratings

problem: Build a complete e‑commerce solution with secure payments, user authentication, admin capabilities, and scalable architecture suitable for real‑world deployment.
approach: Architected a full MERN stack with MongoDB Atlas for cloud database, Express REST API, React 18 with Vite for fast builds, and Node.js runtime
Integrated Stripe payment processing with Payment Intents API for secure transactions—card details never touch the server
Implemented JWT authentication with 30‑day expiry, bcrypt password hashing, and role‑based middleware for admin routes
Built comprehensive admin panel with product CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), protected by admin role checks
Added customer review and rating system with star ratings, pagination, and user validation
Used React Context API (AuthContext, CartContext) for global state management; Axios interceptors for token injection
Deployed frontend to Vercel, backend to Render, database on MongoDB Atlas with full CORS and security headers (Helmet)
Created seed script for 8 demo products, documented 4 deployment options, and comprehensive API documentation
outcomes: Complete e‑commerce platform with user registration, product browsing, cart management, Stripe checkout, and order tracking
Secure admin dashboard for product management accessible only to users with admin role
Production‑ready with responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop), proper error handling, and security best practices
Fully documented with README, DEPLOYMENT guide, PROJECT_SUMMARY, and CREATE_ADMIN instructions for easy handoff
Successfully deployed and live with test payments working via Stripe test cards

title: Smart Expense Management System
summary: Full-stack expense management platform with multi-level approvals, OCR-based receipt capture, currency conversion, analytics dashboards, and enterprise RBAC.
description: Developed a robust expense management system using React.js (TypeScript), NestJS, and Firebase. The platform supports multi-level approval workflows, OCR-based receipt uploads, real-time currency conversion, analytics dashboards, and enterprise-grade role-based access control (RBAC). Features include automated approval flows, receipt digitization, and comprehensive reporting for finance teams.
problem: Enable organizations to efficiently manage, approve, and analyze employee expenses with automated workflows and digital receipt capture.
approach: Designed a modular architecture with React.js frontend and NestJS backend, integrated via REST APIs
Implemented multi-level approval workflows and enterprise RBAC for secure access control
Integrated OCR for automated receipt digitization and real-time currency conversion APIs
Built analytics dashboards for spend analysis and reporting
Deployed using Firebase for authentication, storage, and hosting with Vercel for frontend
outcomes: Streamlined expense submission and approval process with automated workflows
Reduced manual entry with OCR-based receipt capture and digitization
Improved financial visibility with real-time analytics dashboards
Secure, scalable, and ready for enterprise deployment
